title: In the Footsteps of the Ancestors (Ha Ki Dienjat Ki Longshuwa)
cultural_context: Veneration of the virtues, monoliths (Mawbynna), and ethics left behind by the ancient ancestors (Ki Longshuwa).
lyrics_khasi:
Ha ki dienjat ki longshuwa
To ngin iaid da ka akor,
Ki mawbyrsiew ki mawbynna
Ki ieng ban ai ka bor;
Ki la buh ia ka niam ka rukom
Ban tip-kur bad tip-kha,
Ban im da ka hok ka sot
Ha khmat u Blei Uba Khraw.

Wat bamsap, wat phriang nia lamwir,
Bat skhem ia la ka kti,
Ka sniehkoh jong ka Ri
Kam ju let ia ka jingshisha;
Ki sngi ki la leit,
Hynrei ka nongrim ka sah,
Ha dienjat ki kpa tymmen
Ka Ri kan kiew sha khmat.
lyrics_english:
In the footsteps of our ancestors
Let us walk with upright etiquette,
The hearthstones and memorial monoliths
Stand to impart great strength;
They established religious customs
To know one's clan and paternal kin,
To live in righteousness and truth
Before the Almighty God.

Do not bribe, do not spread deceit,
Hold steadfastly to your integrity,
The sacred soil of our Motherland
Never forgets the truth;
The years may pass away,
Yet the foundation remains,
In the footsteps of the elders
Our Motherland shall march ahead.
